name: navigableai-chat-widget
description: Highly customizable chat widget for web applications, supporting any backend or LLM via a custom provider.
author: Navigable AI

scripts.types:sync: echo "Syncing types for main & react app" && node -e "fs.copyFileSync('./src/types.ts', '../react-app/src/types/mainProcess.ts')"
scripts.dev: nodemon --exec "npm run build:dev" -e ts --ignore dist/* --ignore src/consts.ts
scripts.build: npm run inject-version && node -e "fs.rmSync('dist', {recursive:true, force:true})" && npx tsc --project tsconfig.json
scripts.cmd:publish: npm run build && npm publish && git reset --hard HEAD
scripts.build:dev: npm run inject-version && npm run build && npm run copy:dev
